text:
maria: Heads-up — spotted a flaky onboarding cURL example in the README that breaks when folks paste it into PowerShell on Windows.

maria: The example uses this snippet: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

maria: In pwsh the single quotes mean $REDWOOD_API_KEY doesn't expand and the JSON quoting confuses things. New users on Windows are hitting 400 / auth errors. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

jake: ah yeah, PowerShell treats single quotes as literal. Also Windows has curl.exe aliased so people sometimes get weird behavior.

sam: can confirm — repro'd on a fresh Win11 VM. Suggested fixes: show a PowerShell-native example and mention the curl.exe alias. Example I used: 
```powershell
$body = @{ input = "hello" } | ConvertTo-Json
$headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY"; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json' }
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -Headers $headers -Body $body
```

sam: or for folks who prefer curl.exe explicitly: 
```powershell
curl.exe -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

kevin: nice. we should avoid showing the unix-only single-quoted variant as the sole example. maybe add both "curl (mac/linux)" and "PowerShell (Windows)" panels in the README.

maria: Agreed. Also a subtlety: using double quotes for the JSON body in curl on Windows requires escaping inner quotes or using a here-doc style in docs. Better to show ConvertTo-Json for pwsh.

jake: I'll open a tiny PR to add a "Windows / PowerShell" subsection and the curl.exe caveat. Will also update the quickstart snippet in the samples repo.

sam: if you add the snippet, can we also add a one-liner note for CI that runs snippet validation on a Windows runner? Right now snippet CI only runs on ubuntu-latest.

kevin: good call — snippets CI should run on matrix: [ubuntu, macos, windows]. I can add that to the docs-ci workflow.

maria: docs-bot, please file a docs ticket and link the PR once it's up.

docs-bot: Created ticket DOCS-482: "Add PowerShell examples and curl.exe note to quickstart README" and linked to repo https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/312 (draft).

sam: thanks! I'll review the PR tomorrow. If all good we can merge and cherry-pick into the samples README as well.

jake: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/312 — includes two new code blocks, a tiny paragraph about env var expansion, and a CI workflow change suggestion.

maria: sweet. once merged, let's also update the onboarding template in the Console that sends the initial email with the quickstart link — a few people have been copy/pasting straight from that and hitting the same Windows issues.

kevin: noted, will update the Console snippet afterwards.

sam: small follow-up: can we add a short sentence in the README about not pasting secrets into shared shells and to use env vars? saw someone paste keys into a Codespaces session yesterday. :eyes:

maria: yep add that to the security checklist section.

jake: lgtm — I'll ping when PR is ready for final review. :thumbsup:
